name: SIH26017 land acquisition schema
description: Pan-India (multi-state) schema. Mirrors HimBhoomi-style land records + RFCTLARR lifecycle timelines. Semantic IDs encode geography; models never see geo/identifier columns.

id_formats.home_state_rule: For cross-state linear projects, the STATE in the project_id is the state of the first parcel on the path.
id_formats.consistency: Parcel IDs are DERIVED from the parcel's assigned state/district/village (never independent).

granularity.note: Parcel is atomic; project/village/district/state risk is a weighted rollup.

spatial_types.point: Localized project: constrained to 1 district, 1-2 adjacent villages.
spatial_types.linear: Linear project (road/rail/highway): ordered path over contiguous villages, may cross district/state borders; carries coord_path.

statutory_days.note: RFCTLARR-aligned. Declaration/Award are <=12 months; Notification/Possession are shorter administrative steps.

target.delay_days: actual_days - statutory_days (per stage). Positive = overrun. Computed ONLY for completed stages.
target.delay_flag: 1 if delay_days > 0 else 0 (per stage, binary classification target).
target.overrun_while_ongoing: 1 if status=ongoing AND elapsed_days > statutory_days (live money-shot signal, not a training target).

field_roles.geo_only: geographic identifier used for rollup/validation/map; STRIPPED before training
field_roles.hidden: present in data but NEVER a feature and NEVER exposed (confound for cold-start stress test)
field_roles.support: auxiliary column needed to compute/derive target (not a feature)

hidden_confound.state_admin_capacity: per-state hidden institutional pace; partially proxied by stakeholder_responsiveness + historical_performance_score (state x district x individual blend).
hidden_confound.cold_start_split_unit: LODO/LOSO split by each PARCEL's own district/state, never by project.

states.description: State-level metadata. state_admin_capacity is the HIDDEN state confound.

fields.name: admin_capacity
fields.description: Hidden state-level institutional pace; NOT exposed to models or UI

districts.description: District-level metadata. district_admin_capacity is the HIDDEN district confound.

fields.name: district_code
fields.description: District code used in parcel IDs

fields.name: admin_capacity
fields.description: Hidden district-level admin capacity; NOT exposed

projects.description: Project-level record. One acquisition project aggregates many parcels. point or linear spatial type.

fields.name: coord_path
fields.description: Ordered village coordinate path for linear projects

fields.name: stakeholder_responsiveness
fields.description: Responsiveness score (partially proxies hidden state/district pace)

fields.name: historical_performance_score
fields.description: Dept/region track-record score (partially proxies hidden pace)

villages.description: Village geo table (seeded fake coordinates per district).

stage_timelines.description: Long format: one row per parcel per stage (parcel x 5 stages).

fields.name: actual_days
fields.description: Actual days taken (NULL for ongoing/pending stages)

fields.name: elapsed_days
fields.description: Days elapsed so far (for ongoing stages)

fields.name: status
fields.description: completed iff actual_days set; ongoing iff started but unfinished; pending otherwise

fields.name: delay_days
fields.description: actual_days - statutory_days; NULL for non-completed stages
